tweets.text:
#NEW: CBP releases full March report and border patrol apprehensions along the southwest border for the *entire month* of March 2025 were lower than the first *two days* of March 2024

According to CBP, In March, USBP apprehended 7,181 illegal aliens crossing the southwest border between ports of entry. This is a  a 14% decrease from February 2025 and a 95% decrease from March 2024 when USBP apprehended 137,473 aliens.
 
CBP’s Office of Field Operations (OFO) nationwide encounters averaged approximately 673 per day in March. This is 3% lower than OFO’s 693 daily average encounters nationwide in February and 81% lower than 3,464 per day average from March 2024. 
 
In March, CBP seized 760 pounds of fentanyl, an increase of 24% from February. Cocaine seizures increased 32% and methamphetamine seizures increased 72% from February.
